# VENDORED from cl-crawl-job-board-crawler linkedin_jobs_mvp/config/skills.txt on 2026-09-24
# Skill phrase → canonical label catalog used by skills_extract.
#
# Format: search_phrase|Canonical Label[|boundary]
#   - search_phrase is matched case-insensitively against job description text.
#   - Lines with a third "boundary" column require a whole-word match
#     (avoids "r" matching inside "for", "go" inside "google", etc.).
#   - Order matters: list longer phrases before their shorter substrings so
#     "apache spark" wins over a bare "spark".
#   - Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are ignored.
